9-panel cinematic storyboard sheet derived from Image 1. Mix Wide, Medium, and Tight shots of the same scene. No borders between panels.

Layout: 3x3 grid (9 panels) in a 16:9 landscape image.

Scene: Sun-drenched coastal cinematic still, modern social-first lifestyle beauty photography energy, bright natural light with true-to-life color and a crisp coral accent. Scarlett (Image 2) stands barefoot in the shallow wash at Bondi Beach shoreline, wearing an oversized white linen button-down shirt worn loose and slightly open with light natural linen shorts, no sandals. A gentle wave breaks right beside her, white spray misting her legs and the wet hem of the linen shirt; she has just dipped both hands into the cool turquoise water and is running cool wet fingers back through her hair, water droplets catching the light, shoulders open, mid-exhale of pure pleasure as she stands smiling into the salt air with vivid coral lipstick still crisp and bright. Soft white foam swirls around her ankles on wet packed sand, tiny bubbles and glittering spray suspended in air; behind her the open ocean rolls with gentle turquoise-to-deep-blue waves to a distant horizon under expansive bright morning sky, dry pale sand farther back sparsely dotted with a left-behind towel and tan leather sandals. Bright morning sun high and slightly behind creates sparkling water reflections, radiant rim light slicing through the airborne spray, golden highlights on wet linen and skin, clean high-key coastal illumination with airy lifted shadows. Medium three-quarter frame capture slightly below eye level with a fast 50mm-equivalent lens, shallow depth of field keeping her expressive smile and coral lips razor sharp while spray and distant water bokeh softly, 16:9 composition balanced heroic yet intimate, potential energy of pure sensory joy at its peak, wet linen clinging lightly, crystal droplets on skin, editorial tactile freshness matching dewy sun-soaked beauty campaigns.

Every panel is a shot of the same scene as Image 1 — keep the characters, wardrobe, lighting, color grade, and texture consistent across all panels.

No text, dialogue bubbles, scene numbers, or watermarks.

Reference images define identity — keep every referenced character, object, and location consistent with its reference image; never render a reference image itself as a separate panel or subject.
